scope: Public engineering requirements only; not an exhaustive private product roadmap or release authorization.

requirements.requirement: Inventory pinned code, documentation, data contracts and evidence; reconcile requirements with limitations and dependencies.
requirements.acceptance: Complete manifest, cross-reference and independent gap review

requirements.requirement: Maintain canonical current state; distinguish implemented, verified, empirical and production gates.
requirements.acceptance: Versioned state receipt and cross-document consistency test

requirements.requirement: Classify artifacts by sensitivity; no confidential content, credentials, or restricted data in public paths.
requirements.acceptance: Access and publication review; negative tests

requirements.requirement: Least privilege, change review, dependency pinning, secret and supply-chain scanning.
requirements.acceptance: Actual configuration and CI evidence

requirements.requirement: Threat model, application security, network boundaries, incident handling, restoration.
requirements.acceptance: Risk-based ASVS/SSDF checks and independent review

requirements.requirement: Fail closed on publication; check every output route, version releases and support rollback.
requirements.acceptance: Negative publication tests and documented approval

requirements.requirement: Prefer modular components; isolate UI, orchestration, analytic contracts and storage.
requirements.acceptance: Dependency inventory and architecture decision records

requirements.requirement: Persistent storage with verified backups, monitoring and recovery.
requirements.acceptance: Restore and operational acceptance evidence

requirements.requirement: Static checks, unit, integration, contract, property, regression and negative tests proportionate to risk.
requirements.acceptance: CI evidence pinned to commit

requirements.requirement: Browser E2E, accessibility, performance and load tests with explicit budgets.
requirements.acceptance: Measured results, manual accessibility review

requirements.requirement: Separate numerical, conceptual, empirical and decision validity.
requirements.acceptance: Independent data/method and acceptance evidence per scope

requirements.requirement: Test units, conservation, null shocks, stability, coupling and double counting.
requirements.acceptance: Invariant tests and sensitivity receipts

requirements.requirement: Separate implementation from adversarial review; human approval of release.
requirements.acceptance: PR, checks, reviewed evidence and limitations

requirements.requirement: Benchmark assisted-development tools against accepted tasks and total cost.
requirements.acceptance: Versioned evaluation and cost record

requirements.requirement: Keep first authorized end-to-end investigation as critical path.
requirements.acceptance: Existing V3e/V4 criteria met, no implicit gate promotion

requirements.requirement: Test actual user workflows, comprehension and accessible provenance; defer unvalidated features.
requirements.acceptance: Usability and decision evidence

requirements.requirement: Use evidence-based staged delivery; validate before expanding scope.
requirements.acceptance: Recorded decision and acceptance criteria

requirements.requirement: Track development and operational resource cost; defer unnecessary infrastructure.
requirements.acceptance: Measured cost per accepted unit

requirements.requirement: Analytic core remains usable without a language model; any future interface uses explicit validated contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Deterministic replay and fallback tests

requirements.requirement: Model-independent authorization, minimal tool permissions, bounded execution and provenance.
requirements.acceptance: Adversarial inputs, denial tests, provider failure and cost checks

requirements.requirement: Versioned interfaces, dependency isolation, migrations, feature flags and backwards compatibility.
requirements.acceptance: Contract/regression tests and rollback rehearsal

requirements.requirement: Assess scientific, technical, security and maintenance impact before change.
requirements.acceptance: ADR with acceptance/deferral and measured outcome

requirements.requirement: Distinguish measured, declared, imported, estimated, benchmark, hypothetical and unknown parameters.
requirements.acceptance: Schema, provenance, uncertainty, missingness and refusal tests

requirements.requirement: Any restricted-input capability requires explicit access separation, minimal data and lifecycle controls.
requirements.acceptance: Isolation, export/delete, retention and authorized access tests

requirements.requirement: Maintain requirement-to-evidence traceability without weakening existing gates.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewable mapping; unresolved items remain open
